map.为什么月亮对观测影响大？: Why does the Moon affect observation so much?
map.满月亮度会照亮大气、抬高背景，淹没暗弱星系与星云；无月且远离光害时可见星等最深。: The brightness of a full moon lights up the atmosphere and raises the background level, drowning out faint galaxies and nebulae; with no Moon and far from light pollution the deepest visible magnitude is reached.

map.月相基于 2000-01-06 参考新月与 29.53 天朔望月周期估算；月升月: The moon phase is estimated from the reference new moon of 2000-01-06 and the 29.53-day synodic month; moonrise and moonset are derived from the fact that the Moon comes about 50.47 minutes later each day than the Sun, combined with the sunrise and sunset for the local latitude (local solar time). The score = moonlight interference (35%) + light pollution (40%) + cloud cover (25%); the fuller the Moon, the higher the Bortle class and the greater the cloud cover, the lower the score.
